items.title: Frank Tiberi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 30, 2022
items.q: I studied with Sol Schoenbach on the bassoon.

ctx.x: So then you’re playing shows in Philadelphia and it required you to be a good reader, punctual, and good habits. Is that a decent way to put it?

Well that required it of course, because he had all the great shows come in to practice you know and to rehearse and get things together before they’d go into New York. Now the reason why I was you know one of the doublers actually was because I, at the age of oh Jeez, 30 I suppose I studied with Sol Schoenbach on the bassoon. There were no bassoon players in Philadelphia and they would always come in with a bassoon player, they’d rather not so they would want to have you know not the big bassoon players in New…
